📖 How to use

  1. Enter date, distance (km) and time (h:mm:ss).
  2. Click Log Run.
  3. See pace per run, your stats and weekly totals below.
  4. Delete mistaken entries with the Delete button.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I log a run?

Enter the date, distance in km and the time (h:mm:ss or mm:ss), then click Log Run. Pace is computed automatically.

How is pace calculated?

Pace is shown as minutes:seconds per km. Average pace is weighted by distance.

How do weekly totals work?

Runs are grouped by calendar week (Monday–Sunday) showing total distance and run count.

Where are my runs stored?

In this browser's localStorage — private to this device.
